g.text: cmd: just kit-install | pass: prints 'installed ... version=Version: 1.16.0' (or 'already installed'); a checksum mismatch exits 1 and installs nothing
cmd: just kit-pack-check DIR ALLOWFILE | pass: prints 'PASS files=N', exit 0
cmd: just kit-pack-check DIR ALLOWFILE | pass: prints 'FAIL denied=D unlisted=U', exit 1; nothing is packed
cmd: .tools/kit/kit pack DIR -t REF | pass: prints 'Model saved: sha256:<digest>', exit 0
cmd: .tools/kit/kit push REF | pass: prints 'Pushed sha256:<digest>' with the same digest as pack
cmd: just model-guard --kit-ref REF | pass: one line PASS or FAIL with total= avail= limit=; exit 2 means refuse

cmd: just kit-evidence RUN_DIR REF --push | pass: prints 'kit evidence digest=sha256:<hex> ... pushed=yes'; refuses (exit 1) if RUN_DIR holds a forbidden file; only the selected evidence files are packed
cmd: just kit-agent REF --push | pass: prints 'kit agent digest=sha256:<hex> ... pushed=yes'; REVISION in the kit records the git sha and clean or dirty; a dirty tree is refused without --allow-dirty
